llm_same_checks_usd_per_1k.description: Measured cost of asking the LLM judge the same questions, per 1,000 answers.

llm_full_audit_usd_per_1k.description: Measured cost of a full claim-level LLM audit (decompose, then verify each claim), per 1,000 answers.

same_checks_cost_ratio.description: llm_same_checks_usd_per_1k / fast_check_usd_per_1k; validates the token model.

ragtruth_qa_agreement.description: Balanced accuracy of the fast check on the RAGTruth-QA subset.

ragtruth_qa_accuracy.description: Plain accuracy of the fast check on the RAGTruth-QA subset at default thresholds (the like-for-like figure for third-party accuracy).

groundedness_ece_before.description: Expected calibration error of groundedness@1 before calibration.

groundedness_ece_after.description: Expected calibration error of groundedness@1 after calibration.
